## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] Docs / wiki / ADR updated when behaviour or decisions change
- [ ] Breaking changes called out and labelled `pr:breaking`
- [ ] No secrets or personal corpus data in the diff
